name: Exponential Edge-Dependent Asymmetric Matrix
description: Replaced the static polynomial matrix with one that incorporates the vertex indices (u and v) and an exponential term (2^s). This prevents symbolic factorization by SymPy into a simple (su - sv) polynomial, and stops the model from evaluating a single static 3x3 table of valid pairs, forcing it to either write correct edge-dependent evaluation code or fail to extract the 3-coloring equivalence.
